purpose: Executable ledger for the `defeat-rollback-severity` route-support family; normalized schema envelope added in rev0293.
non_promotion_rule: A defeater is an authority-loss condition, not a rival promotional route. Surviving a defeater can preserve existing credit only if the route row, severity test, negative controls, rollback rules, and claim binding all allow the preserved wording.

defeater_rows.target_scope: any cited source, proof artifact, data release, or public carrier on which route authority depends
defeater_rows.triggering_condition: a cited result is withdrawn, materially corrected, found duplicated, loses public access, or no longer supports the load-bearing claim for which it was admitted
defeater_rows.positive_surface_at_risk: release-note, generated-summary, route-row, or claim-language support that treats the source as still load-bearing
defeater_rows.defeated_authority: source-backed route credit and any claim wording that depended on the unsupported source
defeater_rows.minimum_evidence_to_activate: public correction/retraction notice, source-owner update, or independent audit showing the load-bearing use no longer holds
defeater_rows.propagation_action: follow dependency graph, freeze affected exports, and roll affected rows to the most restrictive surviving source-backed state

defeater_rows.triggering_condition: record carrier cannot supply the versioned artifact, metadata, provenance, custody object, or challenge route named in its ledger row
defeater_rows.positive_surface_at_risk: paper-public or repository-public wording treated as replay-public or challenge-public support
defeater_rows.defeated_authority: public-record-credit above the carrier maximum and any route state relying on public custody
defeater_rows.minimum_evidence_to_activate: failed replay or provenance audit of the carrier row, or missing version/custody object at the declared public access path
defeater_rows.propagation_action: quarantine public-record wording for affected carriers and reroute claims through rollback bindings until custody is repaired

defeater_rows.target_scope: acquisition protocol fails replay, calibration, nuisance, or fresh-host requirements
defeater_rows.triggering_condition: a protocol cannot reproduce the required public artifact, cannot expose calibration/nuisance controls, or cannot run on a fresh host where required
defeater_rows.defeated_authority: route-field update credit that required the protocol to have acquired rather than merely described the record
defeater_rows.minimum_evidence_to_activate: documented protocol replay failure, missing calibration/nuisance bundle, or failed fresh-host reinstantiation
defeater_rows.propagation_action: downgrade acquisition-sensitive route fields to forecast or custody-only credit until replay is restored

defeater_rows.target_scope: a hostile decoy passes the same public pattern as the positive route result
defeater_rows.triggering_condition: a listed negative control reproduces the route’s positive surface pattern without the target property
defeater_rows.positive_surface_at_risk: positive fit, reconstruction, entanglement, catalog, or likelihood success treated as candidate-native support
defeater_rows.defeated_authority: the discriminatory portion of route credit and any S3-pocket wording that required the control to fail
defeater_rows.minimum_evidence_to_activate: public result, benchmark, or proof that the decoy satisfies the same acceptance condition
defeater_rows.propagation_action: freeze promotion and recompute state from the surviving discriminator fields only

defeater_rows.target_scope: candidate identity, duality, gauge/frame, or operational-equivalence quotient collapses distinctions used for route identity
defeater_rows.triggering_condition: two supposedly distinct candidate descriptions are shown to be dual, gauge/frame-related, operationally same, or not separable at the route target grain
defeater_rows.positive_surface_at_risk: same/different candidate wording and uniqueness language
defeater_rows.defeated_authority: candidate-identity or candidate-uniqueness credit, while leaving possible operational-equivalence credit intact
defeater_rows.minimum_evidence_to_activate: equivalence map, invariant comparison, or operational indistinguishability result accepted by the relevant route owner
defeater_rows.propagation_action: replace candidate-uniqueness wording with quotient wording and lower affected identity claims to the most restrictive quotient-safe state

defeater_rows.target_scope: observed-sector recovery row conflicts with public records at the claimed target grain
defeater_rows.triggering_condition: a route claims observed-sector recovery but fails a declared public sector obligation or depends on an auxiliary patch outside the route target
defeater_rows.positive_surface_at_risk: observed-sector recovery, broad ToE, or high-state promotion wording
defeater_rows.defeated_authority: S4/S5 eligibility and any local route credit tied to the failed recovery sector
defeater_rows.minimum_evidence_to_activate: public inconsistency, failed crosswalk, or sector-specific contradiction that survives nuisance and quotient review
defeater_rows.propagation_action: block high-state gates and roll the route to the highest state not requiring the failed sector

defeater_rows.target_scope: laboratory quantum-gravity discriminator has confounded mediator, subsystem, decoherence, or attribution route
defeater_rows.triggering_condition: entanglement, click statistics, or phase data can be reproduced by a classical-hybrid, decohered-effective, source-state, or subsystem-assumption route
defeater_rows.defeated_authority: the discriminator-class S3 pocket, not merely the data record itself
defeater_rows.minimum_evidence_to_activate: public nuisance analysis or alternative mediator model reproducing the signature at the stated tolerance
defeater_rows.propagation_action: downgrade to constraint or feasibility credit until the confound is separated by a declared discriminator

defeater_rows.target_scope: formal proof artifact, theorem dependency, or claimed derivation has an unowned gap
defeater_rows.triggering_condition: a proof replay fails, a theorem dependency is invalid in the target regime, or an assumed equivalence is not established
defeater_rows.defeated_authority: formal-support credit above clue or consistency-tool level
defeater_rows.minimum_evidence_to_activate: independent proof audit, counterexample, unproven lemma, or scope narrowing that changes the load-bearing theorem
defeater_rows.propagation_action: quarantine proof-derived route credit until theorem scope is repaired or narrowed

defeater_rows.target_scope: benchmark, learned inverse, simulator target, or decoder overfits a surrogate rather than the native target
defeater_rows.triggering_condition: a reconstruction or learned inverse succeeds on the benchmark but fails target-quotient, shift, or held-out native-recoverand tests
defeater_rows.positive_surface_at_risk: decoder success or learned inverse success treated as native identifiability
defeater_rows.minimum_evidence_to_activate: public holdout/shift failure, target mismatch audit, or surrogate recoverand proof
defeater_rows.propagation_action: cap route at benchmark competence and remove candidate-native inverse wording

defeater_rows.target_scope: survey likelihood, catalog, foreground, systematics, or model class selection turns out to dominate the inference
defeater_rows.triggering_condition: reanalyzed public catalog or likelihood shows that nuisance, selection, foreground, covariance, parameterization, or model-class misspecification carried the claimed signal
defeater_rows.positive_surface_at_risk: cosmology/GW route update or model-class discrimination wording
defeater_rows.defeated_authority: specific empirical delta and any route state increment based on the misspecified inference
defeater_rows.minimum_evidence_to_activate: public reanalysis, corrected likelihood, or systematic audit that survives declared controls
defeater_rows.propagation_action: rollback the empirical delta and leave only the constraint credit supported by corrected public artifacts

defeater_rows.target_scope: frame-relative record cannot be transported as the same public record
defeater_rows.triggering_condition: two frame-relative descriptions cannot be connected by the declared equivalence/transport rule, or the rule changes the target fact
defeater_rows.defeated_authority: frame-public credit and any route inference requiring same-record transport
defeater_rows.minimum_evidence_to_activate: failed transport assay, noncommuting observable result, or missing equivalence map
defeater_rows.propagation_action: reclassify the record as frame-local until transport and public-reference custody are repaired

defeater_rows.target_scope: local subsystem, local tensor factor, or compact-region witness assumption fails in gauge/gravity setting
defeater_rows.triggering_condition: the route relies on a local subsystem or tensor-factor interpretation invalidated by dressing, constraints, edge modes, or boundary degrees of freedom
defeater_rows.positive_surface_at_risk: local-witness, subsystem-independent, or public-region closure wording
defeater_rows.defeated_authority: local-public-witness credit; not necessarily the underlying record itself
defeater_rows.minimum_evidence_to_activate: formal or experimental analysis showing the assumed subsystem structure is unavailable at the required grain
defeater_rows.propagation_action: lower local-witness wording to dressed/relational/asymptotic/code-subspace wording and preserve the residual cap

defeater_rows.target_scope: forecast or planned discriminator fails to materialize as a public record
defeater_rows.triggering_condition: mission, experiment, benchmark, or forecasted public artifact changes scope, is delayed, cannot be released, or fails to meet the minimum public-record condition
defeater_rows.positive_surface_at_risk: forecast reach narrated as acquired evidence
defeater_rows.defeated_authority: forecast-to-update credit and any decision-experiment outcome not realized as an empirical delta
defeater_rows.minimum_evidence_to_activate: public cancellation/scope-change, missing artifact, failed release, or forecast row mismatch
defeater_rows.propagation_action: keep the row forecast-only and block empirical-delta import until a public record exists
defeater_rows.trigger_condition: A forecasted facility, survey, mission, or design corridor is cancelled, shut down, delayed, or fails to produce the public artifacts needed for its advertised update; CMB-S4 closeout and LISA pre-launch progress are handled as custody/runway status, not evidence.

defeater_rows.target_scope: RG, truncation, discretization, or simulation result fails portability across regulator/ansatz choices
defeater_rows.triggering_condition: candidate support depends on a truncation, regulator, discretization, ansatz, or simulation class that fails portability or has no observable cash-out
defeater_rows.defeated_authority: route state above formal consistency or tool-corridor credit
defeater_rows.minimum_evidence_to_activate: public portability failure, regulator comparison, or cash-out audit showing the effect is artifact-bound
defeater_rows.propagation_action: demote to artifact-local consistency/tool credit until portability is reestablished
